rules.title: No secrets in source
rules.description: Passwords, API keys, tokens, connection strings and private keys must come from a secret store or environment, never from code or config checked in.

rules.title: Tests for behaviour changes
rules.description: New or changed business logic should be accompanied by unit tests covering the happy path and failure cases.

rules.title: No dead code or untracked TODOs
rules.description: Do not commit commented-out code. TODO/FIXME must reference a ticket id (e.g. TODO(PROJ-123)).

rules.title: Validate untrusted input
rules.description: Data from HTTP requests, files, queues and devices is validated and size-limited at the trust boundary before use.
